# Virtuse

> Non-custodial hub for Bitcoin-only services. Virtuse never holds your keys.

As of Q3 2026. Indicative 2026 overview – not tax advice. Partner KYC on each platform.

## Bitcoin tax (13 EU countries)

- [Czechia](https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/czechia/): 15% income tax (23% above threshold). Tax-free after a 3-year holding period (time test). As of Q3 2026.
- [Slovakia](https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/slovakia/): 19–35% income tax plus 16% health contributions. No holding-period exemption; every sale or crypto-to-crypto swap is taxed. As of Q3 2026.
- [Poland](https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/poland/): 19% flat capital gains tax. No holding-period exemption. As of Q3 2026.
- [Austria](https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/austria/): 27.5% KESt (capital gains tax). Gains tax-free after a 1-year holding period (private investors). As of Q3 2026.
- [Germany](https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/germany/): Up to 45% income tax (progressive). 0% after a 1-year holding period (private-sale exemption). As of Q3 2026.
- [Hungary](https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/hungary/): 15% capital gains tax. No holding-period exemption. As of Q3 2026.
- [Slovenia](https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/slovenia/): Progressive, up to about 50% on disposal gains. No general holding-period exemption. As of Q3 2026.
- [Croatia](https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/croatia/): 12% on digital-asset gains (2025; 10% in 2024). No holding-period exemption. As of Q3 2026.
- [Romania](https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/romania/): 10% income tax on crypto gains. No holding-period exemption. As of Q3 2026.
- [Bulgaria](https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/bulgaria/): 10% flat tax on gains. No holding-period exemption. As of Q3 2026.
- [Netherlands](https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/netherlands/): Box 3 wealth tax on a deemed return (about 36% of the assumed yield). Tax-free allowance (about €57,000 per person, 2025). As of Q3 2026.
- [France](https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/france/): 30% flat tax (PFU: 12.8% income tax + 17.2% social charges). No holding-period exemption; total disposals up to €305 a year are exempt. As of Q3 2026.
- [Spain](https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/spain/): 19–28% progressive tax on savings income. No holding-period exemption. As of Q3 2026.

Hub: https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/
